Scene: plated grain salad with pan-seared tofu, corn, diced vegetables and arugula/greens.
Vessel: square-ish white plate ~26 cm, 531 cm^2

Food covers roughly the center-left of the plate; estimate ~35% coverage.

grain pilaf (farro/bulgur-style with corn, carrot, pepper): 22% -> 117 cm^2 x 2 = 234 ml x 0.8 = 187 g x 130 = 243 kcal
seared tofu pieces: 8% -> 42 cm^2 x 1.5 = 64 ml x 0.9 = 57 g x 150 = 86 kcal
arugula/leafy greens: 6% -> 32 cm^2 x 2 = 64 ml x 0.15 = 10 g x 25 = 3 kcal
sweet corn kernels (within pilaf, counted separately): 3% -> 16 cm^2 x 1.5 = 24 ml x 0.6 = 14 g x 96 = 13 kcal
diced red pepper/vegetables: 1% -> 5 cm^2 x 1 = 5 ml x 0.6 = 3 g x 30 = 1 kcal
oil/sauce (glaze on tofu and pilaf): 1% -> 5 cm^2 x 0.3 = 2 ml x 1.0 = 2 g x 800 = 16 kcal

Check: 41% covered dinner plate, ~273 g, ~362 kcal - plausible for a modest plated side-style portion.
